description: Boundary coverage for rejecting mutations on a value with no key: a lone removal on a keyless value, a lone set on a keyless value, attaching an observer to a keyless value (which still receives the default) before a rejected set, and a longer interleaving of rejected sets and removals. Every mutating attempt fails without touching the backing store and produces a normalized error line naming the operation and reason.

cases.expected_output:
error=unsupported_operation op=put reason=null_key
error=unsupported_operation op=remove reason=null_key
error=unsupported_operation op=put reason=null_key
